tickerText: [TENNIS] Bejlek stuns No. 1 Sabalenka; Paul saves MP to beat Zverev — American-heavy Cincinnati QF lineup set • [SQUASH] Sana Bahadar wins first PSA title at Bendigo Open, beating former world No. 1 Grinham • [BADMINTON] Delhi Worlds QF day — Satwik-Chirag & Treesa-Gayatri carry India's medal hopes after Sindhu exits • [PICKLEBALL] PPA season opens Aug 31 in Cary; Shenzhen Open underway ahead of Veolia Nationals • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Europe Smash wraps: Lebrun's first Grand Smash; Wang Manyu wins third — Chinese men blank

newsItems.title: Bahadar Wins First PSA Title
newsItems.excerpt: Pakistan's Sana Bahadar captured her first PSA Tour title at the Bendigo Open, rallying past former world No. 1 Rachael Grinham in four games.

newsItems.title: Delhi Worlds: Doubles Carry India
newsItems.excerpt: Satwik-Chirag and Treesa-Gayatri reach the BWF World Championships quarterfinals as India's last medal hopes after Sindhu and Shetty exit in the round of 16.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Open PPA Season
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026-27 Carvana PPA Tour kicks off Aug 31 in Cary with the Veolia Pickleball National Championships, debuting the unified World Pickleball Rankings system.

newsItems.title: Lebrun & Wang Manyu Crown Malmö
newsItems.excerpt: Felix Lebrun beat Tomokazu Harimoto 4-1 for his first WTT Grand Smash singles crown while Wang Manyu edged Wang Yidi 4-2 in an all-Chinese final.
